title: Austin Discusses Kealing Urban Renewal
summary:
*   A dedicated public meeting was held to present the Austin Urban Renewal Agency's "Kealing Project" plan.
*   This special hearing focused on outlining proposed redevelopment and changes for a specific Austin neighborhood.
*   The meeting location at Kealing Junior High School Auditorium underscored the direct community impact and importance of public input on the proposed renewal.

CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
May 06, 1963
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 6th day of
May, 1963, at the Kealing Junior High School Auditorium, in Austin, Texas, at 8:00 P.M.
for the purpose of hearing the Urban Renewal Plan for the Kealing Project as developed by
the Urban Renewal Agency.
s/ Elsie Woosley
